data.long_meaning: The name Durva is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘durvā’, which means the footprint of the goddess Durga. This name is also associated with the Durva grass, which is considered sacred in Hinduism and is used during rituals and pujas. Durva is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and protection. The name Durva carries the meaning “Goddess Durga's footprint” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
